name: Gorilla Chin-Up
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar using a shoulder-width underhand grip with your arms straight and core engaged.
Pull your chest upward toward the bar while simultaneously flexing your hips and abs to tuck your knees up toward your chest.
At the top, hold your chin over the bar with your knees tucked tightly and torso curled slightly back.
Lower your body and straighten your legs back down to the starting hang under full control.
tips: Coordinate the pull and knee tuck smoothly instead of swinging your legs for momentum.
Lower both your torso and legs slowly so you do not drop abruptly into the bottom hang.
